test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was the Viceroy of India when the Indian Universities Act was passed in 1904?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Lord Curzon__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Curzon**

 
 
• In India,** Curzon established a variety of commissions** to look into the police, irrigation, education, and other administrative areas.
 
• During his second time as** viceroy, legislation was based on the commissions' findings.**
 
• He was the Governor-General again in August 1904 and** oversaw the division of Bengal in 1905**.
 
• George Nathaniel Curzon, a** British conservative politician who was born in 1859**, attended the prestigious schools of Eton and Oxford for his education. Before being **named Viceroy of India in 1899**, he held the positions of Under-Secretary of** State for India (1891–1892) and for Foreign Affairs (1895–1898).**
 
• **Lord Curzon (1899–1905): **The Indian universities act was passed during the **reign of Lord Curzon** (1899–1905). Upon the proposal of a university commission established in the year 1903,** it was adopted in 1904.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​**

 
• **Lord Minto**

 
 
• The **17th Viceroy of India was Gilbert Elliot-Murray-Kynynmound,** 4th Earl of Minto. Before becoming viceroy, he served as Canada's eighth Governor-General.
 
 
 
• **Lord Hardinge**
 
 
• During the years 1844–1848,** Henry Hardinge, 1st Viscount Hardinge,** a British soldier and statesman, served as governor general of India.
 
 
 
• **Lord Chelmsford**
 
 
• From 1916 to 1921,** Chelmsford, Lord** (1868–1933) served as Viceroy and Governor General of India.
